name: Universidad Carlos III de Madrid
summary: Public university on Madrid's Getafe and Leganés campuses; 20 bachelor's you can take fully in English, at public fees near €1,000–1,250 a year.

ib.text: IB via UNEDasiss: your IB becomes a grade out of 10, and two weighted subjects (IB grades on the credential or PCE tests) add up to 4. Prove B2 English during year 1.

lastYear.text: pre-enrolment 5–26 June; foreign systems to 6 July

notes: Early Admission (22 September 2025 to 10 April 2026 for 2026 entry) offers 8% of places to IB students not living in Spain, decided 90% on grades.
In the English groups you must prove B2 English during the first year; students from non-Spanish-speaking countries are guaranteed English-group places for two years.
One Madrid pre-enrolment lets you list up to 12 degrees, in order of preference, across the six public universities.
